core_categories: Pharmacy Retail; OTC Healthcare; Vitamins & Supplements; First Aid; Beauty & Personal Care; E-commerce
specialty_focus: Rexall is a leading Canadian pharmacy retailer and drugstore operator, providing accessible healthcare services and products. It operates a network of stores and an e-commerce platform (Well.ca), offering prescription medications, OTC drugs, vitamins, and health and beauty products. While it sells health-related items, it is not specifically focused on wearable medical devices.
key_brands: Rexall Brand, Novo Nordisk Care® Rx, Well.ca, Be Well, others
